This application bundles a separate, unmodified ffmpeg (the static amd64
Linux build from https://johnvansickle.com/ffmpeg/) to encode Math Pad
board+voice recordings into .mp4 files. It is invoked as a standalone
subprocess -- it is not linked into, and does not share a process with,
this application's own code.

ffmpeg is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3 (GPLv3).
See https://ffmpeg.org/legal.html and the license notices bundled inside
the release archive itself (fetch_ffmpeg.sh does not vendor a separate
copy of the license text into this directory the way
windows/third_party/ffmpeg/LICENSE.ffmpeg.txt does -- worth adding here
too before distributing a built Linux package).

FFmpeg source code: https://ffmpeg.org/download.html
This specific static build: https://johnvansickle.com/ffmpeg/
